page.layout: Two columns of index entries under the running head "INDEX." Left column: entries T to U, ending with "U." and the entry "Valesiorum". Right column: entries V and W, ending with the catchword "Welt-" at the foot. No page number is printed on this page.

main_text.head: U.
main_text.l: Vafco de Gama in In-diam Orientalem pe-netrat 42
main_text.head: W.

page.notes: The page is a printed index page, so the entries are set out as lines. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept inside the entries (Waregos re-feruntur, In-diam, pe-netrat, e-vertit, Princi-patus). The running head "INDEX" is printed at the top. The page number is not visible. Several readings are uncertain at this scan resolution: "Uladimirus Ruffiorum" (the second word may be "Ruffiorum" or "Ruffiorum"), "Ruffieum", "Bohemiae", "Ulakku-Khan", and the numbers "52.84", "89.90", "Tzar i.e." and "48.49", which may be misread. The entry "Varegi vid. Waregi." is set in italics as printed. The catchword "Welt-" at the foot right is partly obscured and may read "Weft-" instead. Italics were applied to the lines that appear italic on the scan; roman lines such as headings and some entries may be misjudged. The entry "Trogulbeck Rex" and its numbers are printed as "68", which is unusual, but this is copied as seen.
